To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the minimum energy transmission scheduling problem with deadline constraint is NP-hard, and that we have developed a dynamic programming algorithm for the linear rate-power curve case and a heuristic algorithm based on a shortest path problem formulation for the convex rate power curve.

we obtain optimal and near-optimal solutions, respectively, for the non-fading and fading channel cases with convex rate-power curves, and for the fading case with a linear rate-power function, we obtain a threshold-based optimal scheduling scheme.

(a) for the case of a non-fading channel and a strictly convex power-rate curve, the optimal solution can be obtained by the shortest path formulation; (b) for the case with fading channel and a linear power-rate curve, a threshold based scheduling algorithm is proposed and proved to be optimal;
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of energy efficient transmission scheduling of a set of users over a wireless fading environment with strict hard deadline constraints.
the problem of energy-efficient scheduling of transmissions over wireless channels with hard deadline constraints.
the problem of scheduling the transmission of data over a fading channel, with a hard deadline for each data unit.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our results provide the first tractable solutions to the problem of minimum energy transmission scheduling subject deadline constraints.
, in the case of a convex rate-power function, the Shortest Path algorithm is optimal and, in the case that the rate-power function is linear, the DP algorithm provides an optimal solution.
our results provide a tractable solution for the problem of scheduling transmissions over wireless fading channels, subject to deadline constraints.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for a linear rate-power function, the optimal scheduling scheme is a threshold policy, and that for a convex rate-power function, a threshold policy is a good heuristic.

we are able to provide optimal solutions for the minimum energy scheduling problem for both linear and convex rate-power curves in the case of a non-fading channel and for a linear rate-power function in the fading case, and we provide tractable approximate heu-ristic solutions for the minimum-energy problem for a convex rate-power function in a fading channel.
, for a linear rate-power model, the optimal solution has a threshold structure and can be computed efficiently using DP.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the presence of hard deadlines, it is possible to obtain near-optimal transmission schedules with a simple threshold-based heuristic.
in the case of convex power-rate functions, the Shortest Path problem can be used to obtain optimal solutions.

the optimal scheduling scheme for minimum energy transmission scheduling subject deadline constraints has a threshold structure, and the threshold values can be obtained efficiently using dynamic programming.
